survivors.label: required_gap
survivors.reason: This mutation deletes pre-existing relative-expiry behavior in the same public Cache.set method: with expires_at=None, expires is no longer offset by time() before it is stored in _cache. A 60-second TTL at epoch time 1,700,000,000 becomes absolute expiration 60 instead of 1,700,000,060, and the visible pruning comparison expires<=now treats that record as already expired. The overflow exception fix must preserve ordinary cache writes rather than destroy their positive TTL. This is established at the storage/pruning boundary shown in the patch, not by assuming a hidden consumer or replaying the call. All three selected hidden tests use non-None expires_at and therefore never enter the altered branch. The current full=1/nop=0/mutant=1 scored headers bind the surviving regression.

counterexample.required_outcome: The ordinary pre-existing positive TTL stores expires=1700000060, which is greater than now.
counterexample.mutant_outcome: The mutated branch stores expires=60, which satisfies the retained expires<=now expiration predicate immediately.
